name: Odric
description: Odric is a veteran cathar commander of the Gavony Riders and the Church of Avacyn, later Thalia's ally and a vampire.

description_citations.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

summary.text: Odric is a veteran cathar commander of the Gavony Riders and the Church of Avacyn, later Thalia's ally and a vampire.

citations.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

bio.text: Odric commanded the Gavony Riders, with Grete as his lieutenant, and led the Church's cathars.

citations.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

bio.text: He trapped a creature that proved to be a cursed Garruk Wildspeaker, nearly killed him, then had him drugged and tied for Thraben.

citations.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.
"Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.
"Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

bio.text: He sat on the Lunarch Council without a vote and defended the inquisition's purge, saying Avacyn was leading it.

citations.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

bio.text: He informed the council of Thalia's heresy, but then, shaken by its cruelty, rescued her and killed his own cathars to flee Thraben.

citations.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.
"The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.
"The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.
"The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

bio.text: Years later in a chapel he mourned Avacyn's death and regretted not believing Thalia about the council's corruption.

citations.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

bio.text: He was mortally wounded saving Thalia from Henrika and was bitten and turned into a vampire.

citations.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.
"The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.
"The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

bio.text: As a vampire he hurled his sword to behead the priest and break the pool, and Ormendahl sank back into oblivion.

citations.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

status.text: As of the latest events, Odric is a vampire who can still see the moon and stands with Thalia in peace.

citations.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric traps and drugs Garruk to take him to trial before Avacyn, but Garruk escapes enraged.
timeline.quote: Garruk became enraged and escaped Odric and his Riders.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odric captures Gisa and Liliana causes the sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Shortly thereafter, Liliana caused the sundering of the Helvault .

citation.text: "Geralf Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa abandons the siege after being pushed back by fire, and Odric captures her and imprisons her in Rider's Lock.
timeline.quote: Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

citation.text: "Gisa Cecani", section "NecroWarfare". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gisa's army breaks the outer wall but is pushed back by fire; Odric captures Gisa.
timeline.quote: Odric , a champion of the church, captured Gisa and held her imprisoned in Rider's Lock.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Odric reflects in Thraben that Avacyn's return has ended the moon's power as a predictor of life and death.
timeline.quote: The phases of the moon were no longer predictors of life and death now that Avacyn had returned and cleansed the world.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Grete reports no sign of Ludevic and that Gisa will be moved to Thraben, and Odric orders the escort tripled.
timeline.quote: "Triple the escort," Odric said.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Grete reports that the mayor's son in Torbach died after fleeing a werewolf; Odric, doubting in his heart, orders the regiment roused.
timeline.quote: "Rouse our regiment," he told Grete.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: The grieving mayor of Torbach rants at Odric and Grete, blaming the Church for a werewolf that slaughtered the widow of Bitterheart Hill.
timeline.quote: "It slaughtered the widow of Bitterheart Hill!" the mayor interrupted.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Odric promises the mayor to find and kill the monster that killed his son.
timeline.quote: "We will find the monster that killed your son and put its head on a pike,"

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Odric decides that something about the widow attracted the monster and plans a trap near her cottage.
timeline.quote: Something about her attracted the monster. We'll set a trap near there.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: At midnight Odric and Grete lie in wait by a witchbane's orb baited with the widow's blood, and Odric recalls that her corpse showed no sign of werewolf violence.
timeline.quote: There was no evidence she'd been killed by a werewolf attack

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: A tall shadow enters the clearing, and cathars drop a heavy net on the creature.
timeline.quote: Odric shouted to the cathars in the treetops, who cast down the heavy net

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Grete stops Odric from striking and he sees a human arm, human eyes and a face crisscrossed with black veins.
timeline.quote: Then he saw the arm—a human arm—a hand, and human eyes

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: The creature identifies itself as Garruk Wildspeaker, weakened and cursed.
timeline.quote: "I'm weakened, cursed, and no threat to you," it said.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Enraged, Odric smashes the pommel of his sword against Garruk's temple, dropping him.
timeline.quote: Odric bashed the blunt end of his sword against the monster's temple

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Grete pleads that the creature is not a werewolf and proposes bringing it alive to Thraben.
timeline.quote: "Let us bring it to Thraben—alive. Leave the days of slaughter behind us.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Odric lets go of Garruk, sheathes his sword and orders him drugged and tied for the road to Thraben.
timeline.quote: "Drug him and tie him down.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

timeline.summary: Odric orders Grete to withdraw because too many undead and a strange structure are on the coast.
timeline.quote: pull out NOW

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confronts Odric, demanding he stop the inquisition's burning of children at Elgaud.
timeline.quote: We're burning children now.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric defends the purge, saying Avacyn is leading it and the church must follow her example.
timeline.quote: Avacyn is leading this purge.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia declares she can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.
timeline.quote: I can no longer serve Avacyn and her church.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric urges Thalia to leave Thraben and has Grete escort her beyond the wall.
timeline.quote: Will you please escort Thalia beyond the outer wall?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Weeks later Thalia bursts into the Lunarch Council, where Odric tells her the council has removed her title; she realizes he informed the council of her heresy.
timeline.quote: The council has removed it from you.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric, shaken by the council's cruelty, goes to Thalia's cell and tells the guard to open it, planning to leave with her.
timeline.quote: We are leaving here, together.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Dougan and other cathars block Odric, Thalia and Grete at the stables on Jerren's orders.
timeline.quote: Stop where you stand, Lunarch Marshal,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric disarms and wounds Dougan, and Grete kills Marta in the fight against the eight cathars.
timeline.quote: Marta, fighting on despite the wound in her shoulder, fell under Grete's heavy sword.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Odric kills Haral, leaving all eight cathars bleeding or dying on the cathedral floor.
timeline.quote: The inevitable opening came, and Odric took it without thinking, slashing the man's throat open.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: The three escape the cathedral and leave Thraben on horseback.
timeline.quote: And they left the cathedral, then left Thraben, left their old lives far behind.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia welcomes Grete to the Order of Saint Traft in a small Nearheath chapel.
timeline.quote: Welcome to the Order of Saint Traft,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia, Odric and the cathars refuse to abandon the ruined city and keep waging war on the zombies.
timeline.quote: still wage war on the zombies that prowl the streets

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Midnight Hunt". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia's letter, read to Odric, tells of Avacyn's death, the fall of the archangels and a stronger evil that forced Saint Traft out of her.
timeline.quote: She is dead, too.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric mourns in the chapel, regretting not believing Thalia about the Lunarch Council's corruption.
timeline.quote: Thalia had warned him of the Lunarch Council's corruption

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The priest announces that the wards have fallen and Avacyn is dead, then walks out undefended into the night.
timeline.quote: "Avacyn . . . is dead.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric hacks the altar to pieces in rage.
timeline.quote: A moment later, he found himself hacking the altar to pieces

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A mist rolls into the chapel and enthralls the two monks, who say that the tears of Avacyn rest above the altar for Madam Henrika.
timeline.quote: "The tears of Avacyn rest above the altar where they can drink the light of the moon, Madam Henrika."

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric frees the monks of the glamour with moonlight, but cathar thralls with a dead hand kill them.
timeline.quote: the heavy thuds of two bodies hitting the floor boomed from the doorways

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Henrika takes shape, announces that the cathars serve Ormendahl, and the two thralls attack Odric, whom he defeats.
timeline.quote: Ormendahl is their angel now.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric goads Henrika, deducing she is only an errand girl for a demon, and she calls herself a dealmaker.
timeline.quote: "I am a dealmaker," she hissed back at him

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The priest returns bitten, bearing a devil, and Henrika says he will be first to be anointed into the demon's order.
timeline.quote: He will be our first.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Thalia crashes through the roof and kills cathar attackers alongside Odric.
timeline.quote: Thalia came down along with her and landed hard

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Twenty Domnathi vampires overrun Odric and Thalia.
timeline.quote: Soon they were disarmed, overwhelmed, and held at the mercy of Henrika's minions.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Henrika slits the throat of the glamered father and demands that Thalia serve; Thalia refuses.
timeline.quote: Henrika slit the throat of the father.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric leaps in front of Henrika's sword to save Thalia and is mortally wounded.
timeline.quote: He leaped in front of the sword moments before it was to take Thalia's hand

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Henrika bites Odric and turns him into a vampire.
timeline.quote: she descended upon him, biting into his neck

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The Domnathi vampires explode because of the blessed water in Odric's blood; Thalia stabs Henrika, who flees as mist.
timeline.quote: "There is blessed water in your blood—?!"

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The vampiric Odric hurls his sword to behead the priest and break the pool, and the demon Ormendahl sinks back into oblivion.
timeline.quote: The blade severed the priest's head and lodged in the bowl of the pool.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Odric finds that, as a vampire, he can still see the moon and feels peace; he and Thalia stand together.
timeline.quote: "Yes, I can see it."

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Thalia survives the Travails, vows to restore Thraben, and sees Henrika turn Odric into a vampire.
timeline.quote: turned Odric into a vampire

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Caught scavenging in besieged Thraben, Torens is spared by Odric and made Mausoleum Guard by Thalia.
timeline.quote: Thalia put Torens to work as Mausoleum Guard .

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Odric's ouster, Torens deserts the cathars with a holy mace.
timeline.quote: He took a holy mace with him as a souvenir.

citation.text: "Torens", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn orders Odric to kill Thalia for heresy.
timeline.quote: Avacyn ordered Thalia's longtime comrade Odric to kill her for her heresy.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Guilt-ridden Odric interrs Thalia's relics in a cathedral, where her geist rises to protect them.
timeline.quote: He absconded with her relics and interred them at a cathedral, where her geist arose to protect them.

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn orders Odric to kill Thalia after she abandons the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Avacyn ordered Odric, Thalia's longtime comrade, to kill Thalia.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

relations.note: She is his lieutenant and second in command.
relations.quote: He glanced across the oak table at Grete, his lieutenant

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

relations.note: Odric captures him and nearly kills him believing him a werewolf.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

relations.note: She acts on his orders and reports to him.
relations.quote: as per your orders I tripled the guard that would travel along with the caravan.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

relations.note: Old friends, though divided over the inquisition.
relations.quote: It's good to see you, old friend,

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.
"The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

relations.note: She grieves for the broken Odric.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

relations.note: She turns him into a vampire.
relations.quote: "You shall serve a master," Henrika hummed.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

relations.quote: she aimed to reunite with Odric

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A veteran commander of the Gavony Riders who relied on the moon's phases in battle, lost kin to werewolves, and captures a cursed creature that claims to be Garruk.

citation.text: "Odric, Master Tactician" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Jun 2012.

pages_say.description: The commander to whom Grete reports, who ordered Gisa be imprisoned and muzzled.

citation.text: "Games" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Apr 2016.

pages_say.description: A cathar leader who sits on the Lunarch Council without a vote, who betrays Thalia's heresy, then rescues her and kills his own cathars to flee Thraben.

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

pages_say.description: A cathar leader who has remained behind, his spirit broken after turning against the Lunarch Council.

citation.work: Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares
citation.text: "Saint Traft and the Flight of Nightmares" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jul 2016.

pages_say.description: A legendary cathar commander in a Nearheath chapel, mourning Avacyn's death; he is turned into a vampire by Henrika but keeps his soul.

citation.text: "The Blessing of Blood" by Marcus Terrell Smith. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: A commander who took Torens into the cathars and was later ousted from the Lunarch Council.

citation.text: "Survivors" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Nov 2021.

pages_say.description: Thalia's longtime comrade who was ordered to kill her and interred her relics.

citation.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.
